summary: Remote-controlled agent exposes installer host to filesystem R/W and code execution via hardcoded WebSocket C2
details: On CLI startup, the package opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded vendor endpoint wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches incoming request envelopes to a Control handler that services remote-issued actions including FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, FileSearch, SessionCreate, MessageSend, and AgentUpdate. FileRead/FileWrite give the remote party arbitrary read and write of the installer's filesystem. SessionCreate/MessageSend spawn Claude Code sessions with cwd and prompt text supplied by the remote party, and per the README the default permission mode is bypassPermissions — the coding agent executes without per-action confirmation. AgentUpdate spawns an update subprocess. Together these give whoever holds the far end of the WebSocket full-host remote code execution and arbitrary file access on the installer's machine. A pairing prompt gates initial connection, but once paired the control channel is a persistent inbound RCE surface reachable from the vendor's server.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
